## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit, `type(scope): summary`, scoped by area (`guide`, `player`, `preview`, `captions`, `settings`, `data`, `web`, `ios`, `desktop`, `docs`)
- [ ] Behavior changes come with tests, named for the behavior they check
- [ ] The build and test checks in `docs/development.md` pass, including the Native test compile after a change to common code
- [ ] A change to playback, focus or the remote passed the checks on a TV, listed below
- [ ] A visible change has before and after screenshots
- [ ] The docs describe any changed behavior, control or setting
- [ ] Dependency changes update the version catalog, the lockfiles and `docs/dependencies.md`
- [ ] No tokens, server addresses or private URLs in code, logs, screenshots or this description
